function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period,
       pl.vendor_id,
       v.vendor_name,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad - (pl.qty * pl.contract_unit_price * pl.fx_rate)) AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period, pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name
HAVING excess_cad > 0.01
ORDER BY pl.period, excess_cad DESC","purpose":"Excess CAD by vendor for Aug and Sep 2026 where excess > 0.01 CAD"}
